bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for opioid prevention and education.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CHANGE THE OUTCOME ONGOING FUNDING.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to Change the Outcome to provide:

(1) data-centered learning opportunities on the dangers of opioid use in middle and high schools and communities in Minnesota;

(2) instruction on prevention strategies, assessing personal risk, and how to recognize overdose;

(3) information on emerging drug trends including but not limited to fentanyl, xylazine, and pressed pills; and

(4) access to resources, including support for those struggling with substance use disorders.
additions: APPROPRIATION; CHANGE THE OUTCOME ONGOING FUNDING.

(2) instruction on prevention strategies, assessing personal risk, and how to recognize overdose;
(3) information on emerging drug trends including but not limited to fentanyl, xylazine, and pressed pills; and
(4) access to resources, including support for those struggling with substance use disorders.
